Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly concluded that Jeremy Oxley's birthplace was Sydney based on information visible at the top of the search results. However, further down in the results from Wikipedia, it notes that while Jeremy Oxley was born in Sydney, he grew up in Kingscliff after his family moved there. The task was to find the birthplace of Jeremy Oxley, where Jeremy spent important formative years post-birth per Wikipedia, and thus relates more consistently to Kingscliff. The agent did not fully explore or verify the results, nor did it reconcile this initial search insight with further details mentioned on Wikipedia. This reflects an example of relying heavily on the first visible result without in-depth cross-referencing.
